subsection.title: Primary Persona
subsection.description: - Identify exactly one person who directly experiences the problem and will use the PoC. - If several personas are possible, ask the user to choose the most important one before completing this subsection. - Do not combine several personas into one composite user.

subsection.title: Problem
subsection.description: Describe the concrete situation, friction, and consequence the Primary Persona experiences.

subsection.title: PoC Intent
subsection.description: State what the PoC should make visible or possible for the Primary Persona.

subsection.title: Minimum Build Scope
subsection.description: - List only the minimum user-visible capabilities, screens or moments, and information needed for the PoC. - Include a permission, privacy, safety, limit, or failure rule only when the PoC itself must honor it. - Do not assign Feature IDs or add implementation detail.

subsection.title: Success Condition
subsection.description: State the observable result that makes this PoC successful.
